title: Rating Manual: Excess Vehicles on a Cardinal Personal Auto Policy Vehicle Addition
content:
When a vehicle is added to a Cardinal Personal Auto Policy, the excess-vehicle share applied to its vehicle addition charge depends on how the household's vehicles compare with its rated drivers once the vehicle is on the schedule.

## Rule

The excess-vehicle share depends on how many more vehicles than rated drivers there are once the vehicle is on the schedule:

| Vehicles less rated drivers | Excess-vehicle share | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| 2 or more | 70 percent | The added vehicle is rated as an excess vehicle no one drives regularly |
| Exactly 1 | 85 percent | |
| 0 or fewer | One (the whole charge) | |

## How the two counts are taken

Both counts come from the policy's transaction history.

- **Vehicles.** The vehicles added to the policy less those removed from it. The added vehicle's own later removal is not deducted. Vehicles scheduled at issue appear as vehicle addition entries effective the inception date, so they are counted.
- **Rated drivers.** The drivers added less those excluded and those removed. Drivers listed at issue appear as driver addition entries, so they are counted. An excluded driver no longer counts.

## Cases on both sides of each threshold (hypothetical)

| Vehicle additions | Vehicle removals | Driver additions | Exclusions and driver removals | Vehicles | Drivers | Difference | Share |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 4 | 0 | 2 | 0 | 4 | 2 | 2 | 70 percent |
| 3 | 0 | 2 | 0 | 3 | 2 | 1 | 85 percent |
| 3 | 0 | 3 | 0 | 3 | 3 | 0 | One |
| 4 | 1 (another vehicle) | 2 | 0 | 3 | 2 | 1 | 85 percent |
| 3 | 0 | 3 | 1 exclusion | 3 | 2 | 1 | 85 percent |

When the vehicle being charged is itself later removed, that removal is not subtracted. Three additions and one removal of that same vehicle still count 3 vehicles.

## Worked illustration (hypothetical)

Take a vehicle addition whose full-term charge is 300.00, with 4 vehicles and 2 rated drivers on the schedule. The excess-vehicle share is 70 percent, and 70 percent of 300.00 is 210.00. With 3 vehicles and 2 rated drivers it would be 85 percent, which is 255.00.
